cases.description: Typical non‑empty URI identifier – getId() should return the exact value supplied to the constructor.
Empty string identifier – verifies that getId() correctly returns an empty string without throwing.
Null identifier – ensures that when the JsonSchema is created with a null id, getId() returns null as specified.
Identifier consisting only of whitespace characters – getId() should return the exact whitespace string without trimming.
URN style identifier – verifies that getId() correctly returns a non‑URL identifier.
URI containing a fragment component – ensures the fragment is preserved in the returned id.
Identifier with Unicode characters – checks that getId() returns the Unicode string unchanged.
URI containing percent‑encoded characters – validates that the encoded value is returned verbatim.
Identifier that looks like a format placeholder – confirms that getId() does not interpret or alter placeholder syntax.
Very long identifier (5,000 characters) – tests that getId() can handle large strings without truncation or performance issues.
Identifier ending with a newline character – ensures newline is preserved in the returned value.
Identifier ending with a tab character – verifies that tab characters are retained.
URI with repeated query parameters – checks that the entire query string is returned unchanged.
